description: Authoritative semantic boundaries for the question-bank router.
rules: A question form is not accepted or rejected globally; each label defines its own scope.
A question may enter a label only when it matches the label's overall intent or an explicitly accepted scope.
Questions assigned to another label must not be duplicated across label banks.
Unknown is a fallback decision and does not have a positive question bank.
